scope: Static signed hand-to-visual-object geometry profiles on existing saved six seed0 cases, not physical contacts or evaluation data. Current/shipped/metric target poses already computed in frozen reference report; no retargeting/inference/physics. Preserve bad native proposals.
hand_sampling: Native original vertices (count profile) and area-weighted triangle-subdivision centroids separately. Target actual per-geom compiled convex-hull triangles; analytic boxes; cylinder angular tessellation and normalized octahedral sphere tessellation to <=0.5mm chord error. Primitive query centroids projected onto exact primitive surfaces; area weights retain planar tessellation area, approximate curved area. Repeat all methods at 2mm area-density for first group each object.
target_union_filter: Exclude/record samples strictly inside another target collider with 1e-8m signed-distance tolerance, outward probe entering any other target collider with 1e-8m tolerance, and same-oriented coincident boundary assigned to lower geom ID. Per-geom signed distances classify overlaps. Retained domain approximates sampled union boundary and may include narrow gap/cavity walls; not globally externally accessible boundary.
signed_distance: Exact nearest compiled visual triangle unsigned distance multiplied by -1 for absolute whole closed-oriented visual winding >0.5. Values within1e-7m of visual surface treated boundary0. Self-intersections not exhaustively certified. Fullshape/part distributions and finite sampled penetration maxima; no exact intersection/volume claim or matched hand point correspondences.
miss_definition: Per-finger sampled miss: all retained samples farther than band in unsigned distance to visual object. Separate exterior-gap miss: every retained sample has positive signed distance >band; penetration-only near geometry never asserted physical contact. Vertex counts separate from area weights.
frames: Read native mesh in camera frame, transform via captured T_world_camera into unchanged initial object frame. Each stored baseline pose suppliedq/root applied unchanged for static FK in captured scene. Actual sourceURDFlimits validated already; record narrower rounded scene-bound delta without treating static-only decimal difference as failure.
limitations: Six existing development cases, same MANO shape, no generalization evidence.
Area-density queries finite; max negative distance is sampled maximum not exact continuous penetration depth.
Target hand morphology differs; area fractions/distributions are independent profiles, not matched-point errors.
Projected curved primitive queries have approximate tessellation area weights.
Visual topology closedoriented but exhaustive self-intersection exclusion absent.
Targetburied surfaces omitted; centroid filtering approximates unionexposure and not global airaccessibility.
Miss definitions geometric; no success criterion or low-penetration requirement.
Source URDFlimits and scene decimalrounding differ; staticphase keeps original targets and does not bypass production preflight for rollout.
